utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday at 2 PM on Elm Street? There's a white van with an orange stripe!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Wait, I thought the drive was at the community center, and the day and time haven't been announced yet. Are you sure about Saturday at 2 PM on Elm Street?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, I'm sure! I saw the announcement myself—it's definitely Saturday at 2 PM on Elm Street, with that white van. I think they might have some Sunday slots too if you can't make it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hmm, I'm not sure—I just heard something about a van. What's broken?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, it's not a specific van—it's a repair drive where folks bring things they need fixed, like appliances or furniture, and we work on them together at the community center this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the community center thing. I might have a broken chair I could bring.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Noah, I think you're right about electronics this weekend. The garden shed thing might be something else.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure this repair drive is actually happening? I haven't seen any flyers or emails about it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm pretty sure it's on— I saw a sign at the community center when I was there yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sunday afternoon works best for me, since Saturday is packed with soccer games.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: The drive's Saturday at 9 AM, not Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I must have mixed up the day. Let me see if I can rearrange Saturday morning around the soccer games.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, Pia, sorry I got confused. Let me check—what date did we plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don't think we've settled on a date yet — it's still pending confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Ah, got it. Let's figure out a good time that works for everyone, then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... but, uh, I can't quite recall the details. Did we decide on a date?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, the repair drive is next Saturday! We're fixing up old electronics.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Next Saturday? Right, I think I remember something about that... but what exactly are we fixing? Are you bringing anything?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I'm late. What did I miss about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We're aiming for a 2 PM start, but the date and location are still up in the air. Pia wants to make sure we have enough supplies first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, 2 PM start. Do we know where we're meeting yet, or is that still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I heard about the repair drive. I've got some tools I can lend if you need any.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus! I might take you up on that—I've got a wobbly chair that could use some fixing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem! I've got screwdrivers and a drill that would work great for tightening up that chair.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Noah, I heard there's a repair drive for the community center. I just want to make sure I understand what's needed—could you fill me in on the details?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, I thought it was electronics or the garden shed? Now you're saying community center? I'm getting mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: From what I heard from Mina, it's the community center's tools and equipment that are busted. Did you hear something different about electronics or the shed?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Quinn, I'm going over the supply list for the repair drive this weekend. Do you know if we have enough spare parts?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I think we might be a bit short, but I can ask the folks on Maple Street if they have any extras to donate.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That would be great, Quinn. Let me know what they have, and I'll update the list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's next Saturday at 9 AM at Leo's garage. I've been collecting tools from folks around here.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Wait, I thought the repair drive was on Elm Street at 2 PM? Is that different?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No, it's definitely at Leo's garage, 9 AM next Saturday. Maybe you're thinking of a different event?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The roof, Rosa. I'm hoping the drive can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, the roof! Bring any materials or tools you have, and we'll see what we can do together on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Actually, I thought the drive was on Saturday. But Sunday works too—I'll gather what I have.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm still not sure about the repair drive—have you heard anything official about the date or location?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Not yet, but I heard it'll be this weekend at the community center—just waiting on the exact day and time to be announced.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, I really need a confirmed date soon; I can't just block off the whole weekend.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, it's this Saturday at Leo's garage, 9 AM. Gus is lending some tools so we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, this Saturday at Leo's. I'll bring some screwdrivers too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks Vik. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I heard about the repair drive for the community center—can you tell me exactly what tools and equipment are broken?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: There's quite a mix—a few power tools, some shelving, and the old projector. I can grab a full list when we head over Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Saturday sounds good—could you email me the list ahead of time so I can see if I have any of the parts needed?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Bo, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? I heard there might be Sunday slots too if needed!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday? Sunday? I just know there's a van somewhere. Is it for fixing vans or something?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No, silly, it's a repair drive where neighbors fix broken stuff! The van is just the drop-off point — white with an orange stripe on Elm Street. Saturday at 2 PM, or maybe Sunday if they add slots.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What tools exactly do you have that could help with the community center repairs?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got drills, hammers, wrenches, a circular saw, and even a heavy-duty staple gun. Anything in particular you need?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: The circular saw would be great for the broken stage flooring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal! The repair drive is this Sunday at the community center. Do you have anything you'd like to bring?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, really? I thought it was on Elm Street at 2 PM. Did the location change?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, no, it's always at the community center! Elm Street might have been for a previous event. Same time, 2 PM, but at the community center this Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I hope someone can take a look at the roof. I've been really worried about it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, the roof? I thought the repair drive was for old electronics. Did I get that wrong?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, no, it's for household repairs too. I think they're fixing all sorts of things.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the park benches—it's going to be a great community event!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Wait, I thought the repair drive was for fixing old electronics and appliances at the community center this weekend. Are we doing park benches too?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the park benches are just one part of it! We're also fixing electronics at the community center. Both are Saturday—you can bring your toaster or help us paint benches!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? Hmm, I think I recall something about 2 PM at Elm Street, but I'm not entirely sure if that's confirmed. Did you hear anything?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, Leo just asked me to meet him at his garage in 10 minutes. That's the plan I'm following.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wait, at Leo's garage? I thought it was at Elm Street... maybe I mixed things up again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Faye, since you're here—do you know anyone who might have spare metal sheets we could use for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not sure about metal sheets, but you could ask Sam; he's heading to Leo's garage to help with the drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Faye! I'll track down Sam and see if he has any leads.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure there's a repair drive? I haven't heard anything official.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, it's next Saturday at 9 AM at my garage.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: But who's organizing it? I'd like to see a flyer or something official.
